主要内容: On February 11, 2014, Sangamo BioSciences, Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial results for the quarter and twelve months ended December 31, 2013. The company also announced that its 2014 Annual Meeting of Stockholders would be held on April 21, 2014, which is more than 30 days earlier than the anniversary date of the 2013 Annual Meeting. As a result, the deadline for stockholder nominations or proposals for consideration at the Annual Meeting set forth in the Company’s 2013 Proxy Statement no longer applies. Stockholders must submit their nominations or proposals by the close of business on February 21, 2014. This report from Sangamo BioSciences Inc. dated February 11, 2014, outlines the procedures for submitting proposals to the Annual Meeting. The company emphasizes that any stockholder wishing to present a proposal must provide notice by February 21, 2014, to ensure compliance with the Amended and Restated Bylaws and applicable regulations. The report also includes a press release issued on the same date and is signed by Edward O. Lanphier II, the President and Chief Executive Officer. The document is filed as an exhibit to the Current Report on Form 8-K.
